title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 6, section 3 (Cultus Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 6 Seasonal No Shooting Areas (Section 7)
Cultus Lake
3 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of the Town of Chilliwack, New Westminster District, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Those waters of Cultus Lake to the maximum high water mark during the period of February 1 to September 30. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 30.]
